Name: S Rank Sentinel
Author: MTitan
Punchline: Standalone S-rank travel, parking, tagging, and recovery.
Description: Consumes HuntAlerts and Sonar S-rank reports, uses their coordinates for safe vnavmesh travel, retries missing entities and routes without false-clearing, requires positive kill evidence, parks dynamically, tags at configured HP checkpoints with protected retreats by default, optionally stays to fight solo with Wrath Combo and BossMod after the initial confirmed tag, watches SS chains safely, and resets to Ul'dah on the visited World.
